==Summary==
:{{pov|Omni}}

Tales of a great battle and the [[Dragon Reborn]] spread across the land, sparking conflict between those declaring for the Dragon with those opposed. There are many variations with varying degrees of truth, but the part about the Dragon appearing in the sky above [[Falme]] is constant.
